## Purpose

Describe the user need and the change. Link related issues or corrections.

## Evidence and review

- [ ] I preserved stable identifiers and source provenance.
- [ ] I distinguished publisher statements, curator judgments, and automated observations.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, personal data, or unauthorized source files.
- [ ] I documented licensing and attribution where this change copies or transforms data.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavioral, schema, or monitoring changes.
- [ ] I checked plain language, keyboard use, headings, link purpose, and non-color status cues for user-facing changes.
- [ ] I described material limitations, comparability issues, or disclosure risks.

Delete checklist items that genuinely do not apply and explain any exception.
